reference_cases.quote: Cegeka has a deep understanding of our business and the right, solution-oriented mindset to help us overcome our challenges.
reference_cases.quote_author: Werner Habenbacher, Project Manager at Austrotherm
reference_cases.baseline_challenge: Legacy data warehouse could not scale; fragmented data across D365 F&O created siloed reporting with no single source of truth.
reference_cases.solution: Modern Data Platform based on Cegeka Data Reference Architecture with Power BI integration.
measurable_outcomes: 100% real-time access to company-wide financial and operational data
Eliminated reporting bottlenecks across 13 operating companies
Unified financial consolidation and operational KPI tracking

reference_cases.quote: The central data platform simplifies the integration of various databases and enables the reuse of clinical data in a governed research context.
reference_cases.baseline_challenge: Combining highly sensitive patient data from hospitals, wearables, and clinical trials while adhering to strict privacy laws without centralized governance.
reference_cases.solution: Centralized, governed Azure platform featuring Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold Delta Lake), Azure Data Factory, and Private Secure Research Environments (PSREs) with FHIR/OMOP compliance.
measurable_outcomes: End-to-end GDPR privacy-by-design with 'Hold Your Own Key' encryption
Automated data ingestion from hospital EPD/EHR systems into secure research enclaves
Active multi-center clinical trials accelerated by 4x

reference_cases.scale: 400,000 Members, Core Shareholder of KBC Group
reference_cases.quote: I felt not only the knowledge and experience among Cegeka's people, but also their enthusiasm.
reference_cases.quote_author: Bert Craps, Director & Management Committee Member at Cera
reference_cases.baseline_challenge: Disconnection between member interests and offerings led to rising dropout risk; no structured way to capture behavioral signals at scale.
reference_cases.solution: AI-infused 360° Data Platform built with automated NLP classification of offerings and ML-based member interest vector modeling.
measurable_outcomes: Thousands of cooperative offerings automatically categorized via NLP
Personalized member profiles driving 35% higher campaign engagement
Similarity vectors generating targeted experiences for low-engagement segments

reference_cases.scale: Thousands of psychiatric patients across multi-site care centers
reference_cases.quote: Automating clinical text processing unlocked proactive patient intervention while maintaining ironclad Dutch privacy standards.
reference_cases.quote_author: Data & Analytics Program Board, GGZ Rivierduinen
reference_cases.baseline_challenge: Fragmented clinical notes across silos, high missed-appointment rates, and administrative burden on healthcare practitioners.
reference_cases.solution: Centralized governed Data Lakehouse with 'Gold Data Model' coupled with Azure OpenAI NLP models, utilizing DEDUCE de-identification for Dutch clinical records.
measurable_outcomes: Automated no-show detection preventing significant financial penalties
Unified clinical data foundation enabling real-time suicide prevention monitoring
100% compliance with Dutch AVG and medical privacy standards

reference_cases.scale: Global leader in mobility & tire manufacturing
reference_cases.quote: Cegeka modernized and stabilized our data engineering pipelines, achieving measurable cost reductions and self-service analytics adoption across Europe.
reference_cases.baseline_challenge: Fragmented analytics across fleet, supply chain, and platform domains; heavy manual reporting in Excel and unscalable Tableau clusters.
reference_cases.solution: Consolidated cloud data engineering pipelines with automated QA validation loops, cluster optimization, and unified Power BI semantic models.
measurable_outcomes: Substantial compute cost reduction via cluster and storage optimization
Eliminated manual spreadsheet workflows across EU fleet operations
Accelerated self-service adoption across 4 cross-functional business domains

reference_cases.scale: 3+ Million Digital Smart Meters, Pan-regional Grid Operator
reference_cases.quote: A future-proof cloud data platform capable of processing millions of 15-minute smart meter readings with sub-second auditable precision.
reference_cases.baseline_challenge: Massive data ingestion volume from 3M+ smart meters arriving every 15 minutes; legacy relational systems collapsed under complex tariff calculations.
reference_cases.solution: Scalable cloud-based Data Lakehouse with centralized calculation engines, streaming ingestion, and API-driven distribution to consumer portals.
measurable_outcomes: Reliable 15-minute interval processing for millions of smart meters
Standardized, auditable complex business rules across energy grid transition
AI-ready foundation for grid capacity forecasting and power balancing

reference_cases.scale: Multiple Nordic paper mills and global export footprint
reference_cases.quote: Unifying operational technology (OT) and ERP data eliminated weekly reporting delays and reduced our cycle times by up to 70%.
reference_cases.quote_author: IT & Operational Technology Leadership, Nordic Paper
reference_cases.baseline_challenge: OT sensor data trapped in plant historians while ERP data lived in siloed applications; manual month-end closing took up to 2 weeks.
reference_cases.solution: Modern data architecture with structured 5-layer ingestion (Iron, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum) integrating 6 disparate source systems.
measurable_outcomes: Reporting cycle times reduced by 60–70%, saving 800–1,000+ hours monthly
Decision lead times cut from 2 weeks to near real-time operational alerts
Rollout of unified self-service semantic models to 100+ business stakeholders

reference_cases.quote: Decoupling our operational telemetry from proprietary vendor lock-in gave us complete sovereign control over our sensor intelligence.
reference_cases.baseline_challenge: Fragmented vendor silos across water distribution pumps and sensors; proprietary software locked telemetry data away from enterprise analytics.
reference_cases.solution: Centralized Digital Twin Data Platform consolidating IoT operational telemetry into an open format for predictive maintenance.
measurable_outcomes: Eliminated vendor lock-in with open data storage
Real-time operational visibility across physical water network assets
Foundation established for AI-driven leak detection and pressure optimization
